rows.title: Rust 3.0 ships a new borrow checker
rows.summary: Rust 3.0 replaces the borrow checker, so fewer correct programs are refused.
rows.discussion: Readers welcome it but dispute compile times; one says it rejects fewer valid programs.

rows.title: Postgres is enough for your queue
rows.summary: An essay arguing that a Postgres table can serve as a job queue.
rows.discussion: Most agree a table is enough; one objects that it stops scaling past one box.

rows.title: Show HN: A tiny static site generator
rows.summary: A small static site generator shown by its author.
rows.discussion: Interest in docs use; the main question is how it handles incremental builds.
